title: String Functions in SQL
definition: String functions are used to manipulate and work with text or character data in SQL.

concat_function.heading: CONCAT Function
concat_function.definition: CONCAT joins two or more strings together.
queries: SELECT CONCAT(fname, ' ', lname) AS full_name FROM employee;

concat_ws_function.heading: CONCAT_WS Function
concat_ws_function.definition: CONCAT_WS concatenates strings using a specified separator.
queries: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', fname, lname) FROM employee;
SELECT CONCAT_WS('-', city, dept) FROM employee;
SELECT CONCAT_WS(',', fname, lname, city) FROM employee;
SELECT CONCAT_WS(':', emp_id, fname) FROM employee;

substring_function.heading: SUBSTRING Function
substring_function.definition: SUBSTRING extracts a part of a string.
queries: SELECT SUBSTRING(dept FROM 1 FOR 2) FROM employee;

replace_function.heading: REPLACE Function
replace_function.definition: REPLACE substitutes all occurrences of a substring with another string.

case_and_length_functions.heading: Case and Length Functions
case_and_length_functions.definition: These functions change case and measure string length.

left_right_functions.heading: LEFT and RIGHT Functions
left_right_functions.definition: LEFT and RIGHT extract characters from the beginning or end of a string.

trim_function.heading: TRIM Function
trim_function.definition: TRIM removes leading and trailing spaces from a string.
queries: SELECT TRIM(BOTH FROM city) FROM employee;
SELECT TRIM(' ' FROM dept) FROM employee;

position_function.heading: POSITION Function
position_function.definition: POSITION returns the position of a substring within a string.
queries: SELECT POSITION('a' IN fname) FROM employee;
SELECT POSITION('i' IN city) FROM employee;
SELECT POSITION('T' IN dept) FROM employee;
